scope: One fresh read-only reviewer with bounded follow-ups for introduced edge/support defects. No new build round or broad repeated suite.

findings.issue: Sideways slab-edge impacts bounced without damaging a neighboring structure.
findings.origin: Introduced in round3, reproduced against build02.
findings.resolution: Transfer inward impact/mass damage before the bounce. Independent focused regression passed.

findings.issue: An upright tank could sleep while almost all its mass overhung an outer roof edge.
findings.origin: Introduced in round3, reproduced against build02.
findings.resolution: Validate support footprint and generate tipping/lateral motion. Independent exact repro now reaches ground at[0.58255,2.87849,-14], rotationZ -0.68411 after10s, resting.

findings.issue: A physically settled tank stayed awake on the opposite face of an upside-down slab.
findings.origin: Introduced in round3, reproduced against build02.
findings.resolution: Choose the upward-facing slab face regardless of local orientation. Builder added upright/inverted face regression; all47 final tests pass. This last small fix was directly checked by the builder, not another independent review cycle.

finalSettlingFollowup.result: Pass; no additional issue in the targeted support-graph change.
